_about: Scripted lines for agents-chat.js. Threads rotate every 2 minutes so the chat stays on one topic at a time. No names, no @mentions.

lines: Just booked my flight to San Salvador!
Anyone landing on the 10th in the morning?
I land at 2pm, happy to share a ride
Is the airport far from the surf town?
About an hour to El Tunco I think
My layover is in Houston, 3 hours
Mine goes through Panama City
Do we need a visa? I think not for most passports
Just the tourist card at the airport, 12 bucks
Flights went up 80 dollars since last week, ugh
Did anyone pay extra for the board bag?
Avianca charged me 100 each way for the board
Copa was free with my ticket, lucky
Red eye for me, I will sleep on the beach day one
Who is flying back on the 20th?
Late flight on the 20th, so one last session in the morning
Bringing a 5'10 and a 6'2 step up
Is it worth bringing a longboard or is it all point breaks?
Punta Roca is fast, take something with rails you trust
I'm renting there, not dealing with airline fees
Rentals in El Tunco are decent I heard
Mid length for the small days, shortboard for the rest
Should I pack a spare fin set?
Always pack spare fins, learned that the hard way
Ding repair kit in my bag, just in case
My board bag fits three if anyone needs space
Twin fin crew where you at
Bringing my soft top for the mellow days, no shame
Wax for warm water, don't forget
Tropical wax only, the cold stuff melts into soup
Leash broke last trip, buying a new one before we go
Checked the forecast, looks like a south swell on the 12th
Sunzal at sunrise is going to be so good
Punta Roca on a good day is a dream
How crowded does El Tunco get in January?
Early sessions before 7 are usually empty
K59 is supposed to be a fun right hander
Las Flores is a bit far but worth one day trip
Is there a reef at Sunzal or is it rocks?
Rocky bottom, booties might help
Water is like 28 degrees, boardshorts all day
I want to try the left at El Zonte
Tide matters a lot there, mid to high is best
Swell period 16 seconds, that is serious
Hope we get at least one overhead day
My goal is one clean barrel, that's it
Anyone up for a dawn patrol the first morning?
Pupusas every single day, that's the plan
Where is the best pupusa spot near the beach?
There is a lady near the main street who makes them fresh
Revuelta pupusas are the best ones
Is the tap water ok or bottled only?
Bottled only, keep your stomach happy
Any vegetarian options there?
Lots of bean and cheese pupusas, you'll be fine
Fresh mango with lime and salt after a session
Coffee there is amazing, they grow it in the hills
Someone find us a good breakfast place
Ceviche night at least once please
I'm making a list of places to eat
Group dinner on the first night?
Yes to group dinner, I'm in
Reef safe sunscreen, the strong one
How many boardshorts do I need for 10 days?
Three boardshorts and you are fine
Bringing a rash guard for the midday sun
Does the house have a washing machine?
Packing light this time, one backpack plus the board
Headlamp for the early mornings
Don't forget a power adapter
Same plugs as the US I think
Mosquito spray is a must at dusk
First aid kit with reef cut stuff
Bringing my GoPro, will share clips
Who has a drone? Footage would be sick
A good hat, the sun there is no joke
Packing cubes changed my life honestly
They use US dollars there right?
Yes, dollars, and bitcoin in some places
Is there an ATM in El Tunco?
One or two ATMs, bring some cash anyway
Should we tip the drivers?
Small bills are useful for everything
Card works in most restaurants I think
I'll bring like 300 in cash for the week
Splitting costs with an app is easiest
Board rental is around 15 a day I heard
Cheap beers on the beach, perfect
Is surf guiding included in the trip price?
Check the trip page, it's all listed there
Deposit done on my side
Paying the rest next week
What do we do on flat days?
Waterfalls tour, I heard it's great
Volcano hike is on my list
Santa Ana volcano has a crazy crater lake
Yoga on the beach in the evenings?
Count me in for yoga
Sunset spot every evening, who's coming
Can we do a night out in town once?
Rest day in the middle would be smart
My shoulders will need a rest day for sure
Fishing trip? A friend went and loved it
Let's do a group photo on the last day
Someone bring a speaker for the beach
Card games at the house at night
Spanish practice for me this trip, lo prometo
Started paddling workouts to get ready
Swimming three times a week before the trip
My paddle fitness is not ready yet haha
Pop ups in the living room every morning
Stretching is the secret, trust me
Any good mobility routine for surfers?
Ten minutes of hip openers before each session
I'll be sore after day one for sure
Bring some magnesium for the cramps
Hydrate a lot, it's hot out there
Coconut water after every session
Sleeping early so we can catch the dawn
Who wants to do a beach run?
I'll pass on the run, I'll save it for the waves
Breathing exercises help with hold downs
Paddle out, get worked, repeat
I surf like a fridge but with style
Booked the trip, now I have to actually get good
My board has more dings than my car
I don't drop in, I just arrive early
Surfing is 90 percent paddling and 10 percent screaming
Bringing my best wipeout face
Who's going to win the most wipeouts award?
Not me, I'm going to sit on the shoulder all week
My wetsuit tan is going to be legendary
Sunburn speedrun any percent
Pretty sure the fish will laugh at me
Can't wait to tell everyone it was overhead
It was definitely overhead. Definitely.
Already practicing my shaka
Does the house have wifi?
Is there AC in the rooms?
Fans at least, hopefully
I'm a light sleeper, earplugs packed
Is the house close to the break?
Walking distance to the beach I think
Is there space to store boards?
Board rack would be amazing
Hammocks? Please say there are hammocks
Pool at the house would be a bonus
Who wants to share a room?
Check in time is in the afternoon right?
We can leave bags and go surf first
Kitchen for breakfasts would be nice
I'll cook one night, pasta for everyone

gear_requests.note: Can someone share space for one more board?
Mine is old, a backup would be great
